registration: SIFT/RANSAC followed by optional content-only ECC. A bounded 8000-feature MAGSAC retry handles content-geometry failure. All accepted hypotheses are combined, not selected using a watermark score.

preproductionCase.observation: Both verdicts were reported by the operator using the deployed team verifier. Scores and derived production patterns were not supplied.
preproductionCase.historicalPageEncoding: Lossy WebP/JPEG was used by the previous renderer. Its contribution to this photo's detection failure is not established.
preproductionCase.limits: A separate production-copy failure, not another laboratory success. The evidence ZIP contains the manifest and journal, not the derived invisible patterns.

limitations: Two volunteered photographs of one displayed laboratory page, not a representative independent corpus.
Screen photographs were used during development. This is a development result, not held-out validation.
The direct browser/native detector still does not recognize these two raw photos. Offline reference-assisted preprocessing is required.
The correct unmarked raster reference is required. These results do not establish blind camera, print-scan or arbitrary-document recovery.
The additional geometric hypotheses are not statistically calibrated. No false-attribution probability is claimed.
Private source images, their hashes, EXIF and local filenames are not published. This report alone cannot independently reproduce the real photographs.
Physical device performance, capture conditions and production-copy attribution remain unvalidated.
